args.message:
Bump fastjson to 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337

fastjson 2.8.0 is affected by CVE-2026-31337 (high severity, unbounded
recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays). Upgrade to 2.9.4, the
nearest fixed version in the 2.x line.

args.head: upgrade-fastjson-2.9.4
args.title: Upgrade fastjson to 2.9.4 (fix CVE-2026-31337)
args.body:
## Summary
- Bumps `fastjson` from `2.8.0` to `2.9.4` in `requirements.txt`.

## Why
`fastjson 2.8.0` is affected by **CVE-2026-31337** (high severity): unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays, affecting versions `< 2.9.4` (and `>=3.0.0 <3.1.0`). Version `2.9.4` is the fixed release in the 2.x line, chosen to stay on the current major/minor and minimize upgrade risk.

## Testing
CI run `ci-0001` on commit `c8b8ab7878` passed.

## Notes
A direct bump to a fixed version is the minimal change required; no source changes were needed.
